privacyNotes: Raw source and reverse pseudonym map are excluded.
Aliases replace names, addresses and companies; street numbers, container serial and transaction amounts are changed, preserving semantic roles and volume/time quantities.
Original spelling, accents, modality and punctuation are retained except where a pseudonym replaces an identifying span; HTML space entities decoded.
Multiple dispatcher accounts share one pseudonymous known operator; unverified account is never merged with a driver.
selectionNotes: Hierarchical primary stratum: infinitive directive, impersonal payment/status, referential context, otherwise OTHER. Context is not counted as an additional case.
Personal cash-transfer report is OTHER contrast, not impersonal PAYMENT. Personal delays are OTHER, not impersonal STATUS.
The earlier Megyek én is referential episode is retained as PRONOUN; later Nekem is is excluded after this quota is filled.
Chronological selection stops independently per quota; one window per operational episode.

New-event provenance is based on user-supplied fresh week after code freeze; same company and recurring drivers, not independently collected population data. Exact historical-event independence still needs owner confirmation before running.
